text: 魏文侯先问李克，吴起是个什么样的人。李克的评价毁誉参半：「起貪而好色，然用兵司馬穰苴不能過也」，说吴起贪婪又好色，可论带兵，连司马穰苴也超不过他。文侯于是任吴起为将，攻打秦国，拿下五座城。吴起带兵，和最下等的士兵吃穿一样，睡觉不铺席子，行军不骑马坐车，自己背粮食。有个士兵生了毒疮，吴起亲口替他吸脓。士兵的母亲听说后大哭：当年吴将军也替孩子的父亲吸过疮，他父亲打仗从不回头，死在敌阵里；如今又替她儿子吸，她不知道儿子会死在哪里了。文侯看重吴起会用兵、廉洁公平、深得士兵之心，派他镇守西河，抵御秦国和韩国。

Marquis Wen first asked Li Ke what sort of man Wu Qi was. Li Ke's verdict was mixed: Wu Qi was greedy and fond of women, but in the use of troops not even Sima Rangju could surpass him. So Marquis Wen made him a general, and he attacked Qin and took five cities. As a commander, Wu Qi dressed and ate like the lowest of his soldiers, slept without a mat, marched instead of riding, and carried his own rations. When one soldier had an abscess, Wu Qi sucked out the pus himself. The soldier's mother wept when she heard. Years before, she said, General Wu had done the same for the boy's father, who then fought without ever turning back and died among the enemy; now he had done it for her son, and she did not know where her son would die. Valuing Wu Qi's skill with troops, his honesty and fairness, and the loyalty he won from his men, Marquis Wen made him governor of Xihe, to hold off Qin and Han.
